reason: My guests are regulars who hand me a card or cash at the counter, and my terminal already works. I might scan the free months out of curiosity, but I would not pay 59 lari a month plus another transaction fee on top of what my bank already takes.
objection: Most of my guests won't bother paying by QR, so I'd be paying 59 lari and an extra fee for something a handful of people use, and I can't see from this how many new guests it actually brings me.
would_change_my_mind: Proof from a café my size in Tbilisi that guests really pay by QR and that the offers bring back enough extra visits to cover the 59 lari and the fees, plus a per-transaction fee no higher than my current terminal.
